plans.goal: Collapse the entire pack with environmental hazards: rockslide and avalanche
steps: Trigger the rockslide from the west to scatter the wolves
Bring down the snow cornice to crush the Grey Mother in her own den
Clean up any survivors from the chaos

atoms.strategy: activate western rockslide for area denial
atoms.text: Start the rockslide on the west — send those boulders rolling south and break their formation
Pip, move left through the high ground while they're dodging rocks — get around the Pale wolf
I'll move up the center toward the den — Mother will come to me, and that's when we drop the cornice
Once Mother charges in, bring down the snow cornice from above — bury her and anything else in the den

atoms.strategy: mop up survivors after environmental damage
atoms.text: Borin and Maud, once the snow settles, we finish anything still moving — quick and clean

plans.goal: Isolate and kill the Grey Mother first, then hunt down the scattered pack
steps: Force the Alpha away from her pack mates into open ground
Pour everything into the Grey Mother's defeat
Hunt the remaining wolves before they can regroup

atoms.text: I'm moving straight up the center — Grey Mother, come and take what you think is yours
Borin, hold the line — don't let the Pale wolf or Torn-ear help their mother
Everyone, the Grey Mother is our target — if she falls, the pack loses teeth and will
Pip, move to the high rocks — hit her flank while Maud readies healing for when she hits back
When Mother staggers, I drive the blade home — finish this before her packmates can save her
Once the Grey Mother falls, we hunt the rest — don't let them rally or escape

plans.goal: Hold the high ground and use terrain to grind down their numbers advantage
steps: Position on the elevated tor and make them come uphill
Use fallen logs for cover and choke points
Trade our superior positioning for their superior strength

atoms.text: Everyone, move to the elevated tor — we hold the high ground and they come uphill to meet us
Use the fallen logs as barriers — stack them between us and the approaching pack
Borin, anchor on the left log — make them funnel through the center where we can hit them concentrated

atoms.strategy: pressure lead wolf to keep momentum
atoms.text: I'll keep forward pressure on the Pale wolf — keep it coming so it doesn't think
Maud, position behind the logs — stay ready to heal, but don't expose yourself if they breach
Pip, from your high position, watch for any wolf trying to outflank us around the rocks — hit them hard
